query.mssql: WITH project_ids(id) AS ( SELECT @projectId as porject_id UNION ALL SELECT p.Id FROM Sungero_Docflow_Project p INNER JOIN project_ids pi ON p.LeadingProject_Project_Sungero = pi.id ) SELECT * FROM project_ids;
query.postgres: WITH recursive project_ids(id) AS ( SELECT @projectId as Id UNION ALL SELECT p.Id FROM Sungero_Docflow_Project p INNER JOIN project_ids pi ON p.LeadingProject_Project_Sungero = pi.id ) SELECT * FROM project_ids;
